labels.function_help_meditation_hall: Meditation hall: two or more meditation mats under a roof, where the tree's qi is dense (0.5 or more). Sitting on a mat there goes 1.3 times as fast.
labels.function_help_tribulation_ground: Tribulation ground: two or more formation stones under the open sky on at least six cut stone, ten blocks from any home. Near the tree a trial there counts as sanctuary, and the stones draw the lightning so nothing is scorched.
labels.function_help_library: Scripture library: two or more scripture shelves and a lectern under a roof, with a door. The sect copies its members' techniques into manuals, and members learn from the manuals three times as often.
labels.function_help_meditation_room: Meditation room: exactly one meditation mat and an incense burner under a roof, with a door, where the tree's qi is dense. One cultivator of Qi Refining or beyond sits there in seclusion, 1.5 times as fast.
labels.function_help_tribulation_chamber: Tribulation chamber: a tribulation array under a roof, a thunder spire in the roof under the open sky, a door and at least twelve cut stone, ten blocks from any home. A trial inside is gentler, counts as sanctuary near the tree, and the spire takes every stray strike.
labels.function_help_infirmary: Infirmary: two or more beds and a medicine cabinet under a roof, with a door. The hurt heal three times as fast there, and a cultivator's cracked foundation slowly mends.
labels.function_help_spirit_array: Spirit-gathering array: four or more spirit jade under the open sky on at least five cut stone. Qi round it is as dense as under the tree's crown: a place to cultivate far from the trunk.
labels.function_help_sect_gate: Mountain gate: two or more sect banners and two lacquered pillars on a cut-stone threshold. Seekers of the Way come twice as often, and cultivators living there join the sect more readily.
labels.function_help_ancestral_hall: Ancestral hall: two or more memorial tablets and an incense burner under a roof. The relics at the tree steady the sect's trials at home as well as in the sanctuary, and each tablet keeps one more relic's help.
labels.function_help_precept_stele: Precept stele: a precept stele under the open sky on at least four cut stone. The sect's doctrine changes far more slowly.
labels.function_help_bell_tower: Bell tower: a bronze bell under a roof. When wolves or raiders come near, the bell rings and everyone living there knows at once.
labels.function_help_lecture_hall: Lecture hall: a lectern and four or more benches under a roof, with at least 12 blocks of roofed floor. Sect members spend their leisure there hearing the Way expounded, and their cultivation moves on.
